evaluation.overall_comment: The translation is broadly aligned line by line and preserves the dialogue’s overall scientific progression, formulas, and numerical statements. However, it has a conspicuous mixed-script speaker-label corruption, an intrusive Arabic word, duplicated text, and significant technical terminology errors—most notably translating “wave function” as “ತರಂಗ ಉತ್ಪನ್ನ” (“wave product”). Several phrases are also awkward or overly literal Kannada, so the result needs careful technical and linguistic revision.
